```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
```
# Read gene annotation
```{r}
gene_annotation <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff") %>% filter(V3=="gene")
gene_annotation$V9 <- gsub('.*Name=', '', gene_annotation$V9)
gene_annotation$V9 <- gsub(';.*', '', gene_annotation$V9)
colnames(gene_annotation) <- c("chrom", "source", "type", "start", "stop", "score","strand", "phase", "id")
```

```{r}
gene_annotation <- gene_annotation %>%
  mutate(
    chrom_int  = as.integer(gsub("Chr", "", chrom)),
    cis_start  = pmax(0, start - 5000),
    cis_end    = stop + 5000) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, chrom_int, cis_start, cis_end)
gene_annotation <- na.omit(gene_annotation)
#  Assemble & keep top SNP per gene 
gwas_dir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_individual_genes/ddm1/with_K"
files    <- list.files(gwas_dir, pattern = "\\.assoc\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

library(pbapply)
library(data.table)
library(parallel)

n_files    <- length(files)
progress_f <- tempfile()  # temp file to track progress
writeLines("0", progress_f)

library(pbmcapply)

top_snps <- rbindlist(pbmclapply(files, function(f) {
  gene_id <- strsplit(basename(f), "\\.")[[1]][1]
  coords  <- gene_annotation[gene_annotation$id == gene_id, ]
  if (nrow(coords) == 0) return(NULL)
  dt  <- fread(f, select = c("chr", "ps", "p_wald", "beta", "se", "af"), showProgress = FALSE)
  cis <- dt[chr == coords$chrom_int & ps >= coords$cis_start & ps <= coords$cis_end]
  if (nrow(cis) == 0) return(NULL)
  top <- cis[which.min(p_wald)]
  top[, gene := gene_id]
  top
}, mc.cores = 8), fill = TRUE)

# ── 3. Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fwrite(top_snps, "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/top_cis_eqtl_per_gene_f1ddm1_5karound_the_gene.tsv", sep = "\t")
message("Done: ", nrow(top_snps), " genes with a top cis SNP")
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Add gene position to top_snps
top_snps_ann <- top_snps %>%
  left_join(gene_annotation %>% 
              mutate(gene_mid = (cis_start + cis_end) / 2) %>%
              dplyr::select(id, chrom_int, gene_mid), 
            by = c("gene" = "id", "chr" = "chrom_int"))

ggplot(top_snps_ann, aes(x = gene_mid, y = ps, color = -log10(p_wald))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  #facet_wrap(~chr, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "-log10(p)") +
  labs(x = "Gene position", y = "Top SNP position", title = "Cis-eQTL diagonal plot") +
  theme_bw()
top_snps_ann$pwald_log10 <- -log10(top_snps_ann$p_wald)
```
## Results for selected genes on chromosome 5 
```{r}
chr5_result <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/chr5.txt")

chr5_result_with_cis_regulation <- left_join(chr5_result, top_snps_ann, by=c("DB identifier"="gene"))
chr5_result_with_cis_regulation[, pwald_log10 := round(pwald_log10, 3)]
chr5_result_with_cis_regulation[, p_wald := signif(p_wald, 4)]

fwrite(chr5_result_with_cis_regulation, 
       "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/peaks_analysis/chr5_ddm1_cis_eqtl.csv", 
       sep = ";", dec = ",", na = "NA", quote = TRUE)
```
